scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings packages test scripts vitest.config.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.base.json
scripts.version:patch: node scripts/sync-versions.js --bump patch && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm install
scripts.version:minor: node scripts/sync-versions.js --bump minor && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm install
scripts.version:major: node scripts/sync-versions.js --bump major && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm install
scripts.publish: pnpm run prepublishOnly && pnpm -r publish --access public
scripts.publish:dry: pnpm run prepublishOnly && pnpm -r publish --access public --dry-run
